artifact.hota.artifacts.capeOfSilence.de:
{Cape of Silence}

While wearing this cape, neither you nor your opponent will be able to cast level 1-2 spells during combat.
artifact.hota.artifacts.capeOfSilence.ev: As you pass the graveyard, you notice an old man mourning over his wife. As you approach him, the old man falls dead. After burying him, you decide to take his cape.
artifact.hota.artifacts.charmOfEclipse.d:
{Charm of Eclipse}

This item reduces the Power skill of enemy hero by 10% during combat.
artifact.hota.artifacts.charmOfEclipse.e: While messing around with a curious trinket that you managed to trade something equally unneeded for at a peddler, you find that, although it's made of metal, it doesn't reflect the sun rays, but rather absorbs them readily.
artifact.hota.artifacts.crownOfTheFiveSe:
{Crown of the Five Seas}

Worn on the head, this item increases your Knowledge skill by +6.

You hardly set a camp, leaving the saddle for the first time for the day, as some critter sneaked up on you and pulled one of your boots in his hole. Swearing silently, you search the hole with your hand. Instead of a boot, you touch something sharp. Amazed, you pull out a crown.
During your overnight stay you hear hooves clatter nearby. You look around in darkness and notice a demon's figure, ready to stab you with its horns. You barely survive the attack and keep his horseshoe as a trophy.
artifact.hota.artifacts.diplomatsCloak.e: You met an unusual scarecrow today. Instead of scaring the, well, crows, it was intelligently persuading them to leave the field. You agreed to help the scarecrow to find the closest seer in exchange for the secret. The scarecrow gives you its cloak.
artifact.hota.artifacts.goldenGoose.desc:
{Golden Goose}

Counting component effects the Golden Goose increases your income by 7000 gold per day.
artifact.hota.artifacts.goldenGoose.even: You wander on an abandoned house of a collector in search for a camp place. Most of the goods were long stolen by the marauders, but you were able to find a couple of dusty pet statues. You vaguely recognize one of them. You rub the dust off one of them, and discover a golden goose.
artifact.hota.artifacts.goldenGoose.name: Golden Goose
artifact.hota.artifacts.hideousMask.even: You meet a traveling circus on your way. One of the artists had such a deft disguise that you have drawn a sword, ready to defend yourself. It appeared that a pretty actress was hiding behind the mask. Laughing, she gifts you the mask.
artifact.hota.artifacts.hideousMask.name: Hideous Mask
artifact.hota.artifacts.ironfistOfTheOgr:
{Ironfist of the Ogre}

Counting component effects the Ironfist of the Ogre gives hero +5 Attack, +5 Defence, +4 Power, and +4 Knowledge. Casts these spells on expert level at the beginning of combat on all of your creatures for 50 rounds: Haste, Bloodlust, Fire Shield, and Counterstrike.

On passing by a small cave you hear deep thumping. You enter the cave and see a juvenile Cyclops cracking nuts with an enormous hammer. Every strike ends in shells and nut pieces being scattered all over the cave. You teach the Cyclops to crack nuts more sparingly by crushing them against each other. Overjoyed with this discovery, the youth gifts you the hammer.
artifact.hota.artifacts.pendantOfDownfal:
{Pendant of Downfall}

Worn about the neck, this item decreases enemy's Morale by 2.

You visit the jeweler's shop. You land your eyes on a bracelet, but the shopkeeper immediately warns you that it is cursed. You fear no curses, and put the bracelet on immediately. The bracelet vanishes in a flash. Enraged, you are about to kill the shopkeeper, but he offers you Pendant of Downfall in return. You agree.
artifact.hota.artifacts.pendantOfReflect:
{Pendant of Reflection}

Counting component effects this item increases your chance to resist a hostile spell by 50%.

Soldiers approach you with talks about a miracle. You are intrigued and follow them. You see a strange sight indeed; a wanderer sitting on top of the fire trap, without any harm. You offer him money in exchange for the secret, but he laughs and vanishes in the air. You see a strange pendant left in the middle of the trap.
artifact.hota.artifacts.plateOfDyingLigh:
{Plate of Dying Light}

Worn on a torso, this item reduces the Power skill of enemy hero by 25% during combat.

The goblin you met at the tavern is acting incredibly brazenly, and the reason for that is obviously the luxurious armor on his chest. It becomes apparent quickly that the armor offers poor protection from a good kick in the ass, yet it still is good for something — but how would a dumb goblin know that?
artifact.hota.artifacts.ringOfOblivion.d:
{Ring of Oblivion}

Worn on a finger, this item makes all losses in the battle irrevocable:  lost creatures in a unit cannot be restored by any means, and corpses disappear right after the unit's death.
artifact.hota.artifacts.ringOfOblivion.e: You stand on a field, where a large battle was fought not so long ago. You are troubled by the complete absence of corpses. Amongst the broken swords and armors you discover a ring.
artifact.hota.artifacts.ringOfSuppressio:
{Ring of Suppression}

Worn on the finger, this ring decreases enemy's Morale by 1.
You ordered fried eggs for breakfast. The cook managed to find the eggs for you. He also found a ring in the bird's nest that he passed to you.
{Royal Armor of Nix}

Worn on the torso, this item increases your Power skill by +6.

You see a fight on a hill nearby. As you get closer, you see two nix. One is winning, and as he is about to land a finishing blow, you intervene. The defeated nix thanks you for your help, and gifts you with his armor. He believes you deserve it more than he does.
artifact.hota.artifacts.runesOfImminency:
{Runes of Imminency}

Decrease enemy's Luck by 1.

Close by, on a mountain edge you see a mage trying to cast a  Fiery symbols are already flashing in the sky, when he, while blinded by the light, trips and falls down. The mage perishes, and you gather the chain of mysterious stones in your backpack.
artifact.hota.artifacts.sealOfSunset.des:
{Seal of Sunset}

Worn on a finger, this item reduces the Power skill of enemy hero by 10% during combat.
artifact.hota.artifacts.sealOfSunset.eve: It's never nice to get hit in the noggin by a fist with a heavy ring on the finger. Still, that's what happened to you in a friendly sparring with an old hero acquaintance, and after that, you couldn't manage the simplest spell to relieve dizziness for quite a while. During the booze-up after the sparring, the ring migrated over to your digit.
artifact.hota.artifacts.shamansPuppet.ev: The day looked not so great from the beginning. You walked under the ladder, met a woman with an empty bucket and stepped on a black cat. Apparently, it is not your misfortune, but the guy in rugs who has been following you. You order to seize the loser, but he runs away. As he vanishes, you notice a strange doll that he dropped.
artifact.hota.artifacts.shieldOfNavalGlo:
{Shield of Naval Glory}

This left-handed item increases your Defense skill by +7.
You meet an old admiral at the tavern. After a couple of hours full of tales about glorious battles and days long passed he gifts you his parade shield.
artifact.hota.artifacts.sleepkeeper.desc:
{Sleepkeeper}

Gives your units mind spells immunity.
artifact.hota.artifacts.sleepkeeper.even: You are seeing the same dream for the third night already. A stranger begs you to buy an enchanted broom. You refuse every time, but the dream repeats night by night. You ask the first witch doctor you meet for help, but instead of a potion he gives you a plain statuette, ensuring that it will solve your problem. Having bought the statuette, you suddenly realize the witch doctor is sinisterly similar to the stranger from your dreams.
artifact.hota.artifacts.sleepkeeper.name: Sleepkeeper
artifact.hota.artifacts.tridentOfDominio:
{Trident of Dominion}

This right-handed weapon increases your Attack skill by +7.

You finally found a well after a long search. Your soldiers could not get the bucket of water out, however. Something was preventing it from coming out. Your banner carrier had to descend in the well himself. It appeared that a trident was blocking the way.
artifact.hota.artifacts.wayfarerBoots.de:
{Wayfarer's Boots}

Worn on the feet, these boots remove movement penalty on rough terrains, allowing to move at 100% cost on any terrain.
artifact.hota.artifacts.wayfarerBoots.ev: You meet a wanderer in rugs on a shallow path. He offers you to exchange your cape for his old boots. You agree without much of enthusiasm. As he disappears over the horizon you realize the advantage of the transaction.
artifact.hota.cannon.cannon.description:
{Cannon}

Use this war machine to target your enemy troops and fortifications in combat.
artifact.hota.cannon.cannon.event: Lucky you, you've found a shiny and unused cannon :)
artifact.hota.cannon.cannon.name: Cannon
artifact.hota.neutralcreatures.hornOfThe:
{Horn of the Abyss}

Using the spell of Horn of the Abyss, you can rise Fangarms from any corpses from both side, except non-living creatures.

This waterfall sounds and looks exactly like a waterfall should. On closer inspection, though, you are amazed to find out the flow is headed upwards. You wonder what it took for such an impressive phenomenon to come into being. Surely a powerful artifact has to be in play? And indeed, an ornate horn is soon found levitating above the crest.
artifact.hota.supplementary.fangOfTheLas:
{Fang of the Last Scream}

Held with the right hand, Fang of the Last Scream gives +5 to hero's attack skill. It also gives the specialty of Bloodlust to hero who equipped it.
After exploring in the dark swamp for a long time, you finally found a steel battle claw. You picked it up, hoping that it could help you cut down the brambles and get out of this endless swamp.
{Battle Garb of Anduran}

It is said that its bearer walks in the light of the gods themselves. Increases all primary skills by +5, and Morale and Luck by +3. Allows the hero to cast {Town Portal} at the highest level.
You've heard that the Battle Garb of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
artifact.hota.supplementary.greatBattleB:
{Great Battle Bow}

Great Battle Bow increases hero's Archery skill by +15%.

An archer trying to draw the huge bow, but he couldn't do it no matter how hard he tried. Then you passed by and easily drew the bow, leaving him stunned. He was too embarrassed to ask for the bow back.
artifact.hota.supplementary.greatWoeOfTh:
{Great Woe of the Crawlers}

The Great Woe of the Crawlers is an ancient weapon from Pactal's family. It increases all your Primary Skills by 3, and increases Fortress creatures' damages by 30% and speed by 2.
The sharp claws sticking out of the ground make you think it is the remains of some beast, but when you get closer, you find the Great Woe of the Crawlers.
artifact.hota.supplementary.helmetAndura:
{Helmet of Anduran}

The mind of its bearer remains clear and undisturbed. Increases Knowledge by +5.
You've heard that the Helmet of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
artifact.hota.supplementary.hollowEye.de:
{Hollow Eye}

The Hollow Eye increases the scouting radius by +2. It also makes hero's troops immune to Blind spell.
artifact.hota.supplementary.hollowEye.ev: After exploring in the dark swamp for a long time, you finally found a mysterious spyglass. You picked it up, hoping that it could help you get out of this endless swamp.
artifact.hota.supplementary.plateAnduran:
{Breastplate of Anduran}

Magical energy flows through it with extraordinary strength. Increases Spell Power by +5.
You've heard that the Breastplate of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
artifact.hota.supplementary.shieldAndura:
{Shield of Anduran}

Legend says it has withstood even the most devastating blows. Increases Defense by +5.
You've heard that the Shield of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.
artifact.hota.supplementary.swordAnduran:
{Sword of Anduran}

Its blade shines with righteous fury. Increases Attack by +5.
You've heard that the Sword of Anduran is the equipment of a holy knight, so you pick it up, hoping that its divine light will protect you.

creatures.hota.cannon.cannon.description:
{Cannon}

Cove War Machine.

{gold|Special Ability : Ranged attack. Can attack siege walls}
The formula for the calculation of cannon damage is (4–7)*(hero's attack + 1).
Is put in place of the Ballista (War Machine 1) slot of a hero and during battle. It cannot be put in a backpack.

Effect of Artillery skill

{gold|Advanced.} Gives you control of the cannon. Double damage on unit, aimed shot with increased damage on the fortifications.
{gold|Expert.} Gives you control of the cannon. Triple damage on unit, aimed shot with maximum damage on the fortifications.
creatures.hota.cove.haspid.description:
{Haspid}

Sea Serpents are legendary monsters which known for three things. First - they have very tasty meat, that is why sailors and poachers hunt them. Second - Sea Serpents are huge, thus the hunting process is so difficult. And the last and very important thing: Sea Serpents are very aggressive predators. Therefore, Serpents often turn from victim to catcher. In the battle with these monsters drowned countless number of ships. Haspids are mature representatives of Sea Serpents. They are worth more than their younger relatives due to the special fatty layer that forms over the years under their skins. Usually Haspid attacks ships, preferring to drag away their under water and kill then drowning victims by powerful poison.

{gold|Special Ability : Poisonous. Revenge}
Revenge ability - Haspids have an increase to the Damage parameter before the attack. In layman's terms, an injured Haspid stack fights slightly better, and as some Haspids die, the total damage of the stack will decrease less than usual.

Poisonous is a special ability of Sea Serpents/Haspids/Wyvern Monarchs. It may occur after they have attacked or retaliated target creature stack. The chance of poisoning the target is 30%. Poison and its effects can only be removed with the Cure spell.
When poisoned, the target stack's maximum health is decreased by 10% for every combat round for three rounds. The reduction is always calculated from the creature stack's statistical maximum health. The effect is cumulative, which means that after three rounds the poisoned creature has lost 30% of its maximum health. After three rounds, the creature is no longer poisoned, but the maximum health remains decreased. The same troop can be poisoned again, but the maximum health will decrease only up to 50%. The reduction of maximum health does not kill the creatures, but it makes them more vulnerable.
Immediately after a poisonous effect, 10% of previous maximum health is reduced, and the amount of health left is reduced by the same amount. There is no change even if it takes a poisonous effect again. Do not be fooled by graphic effects. Each stack can only be applied once per round. We want at least 5 rounds for maximum poisonous effect.
The possible poisoning effect takes place after the attack and before the stack has chance to retaliate. The effect of poison has multiplicative effect with Ghost Dragon's aging ability. This means, that the creature stack's health could potentially be quartered.
If the stack is poisoned, it is resurrected faster as Resurrection spell takes its HP after poisoning into account.
Sea Serpents and Haspids are living Dragons, so can be transformed into Bone Dragons at a Skeleton Transformer. Creatures with Slayer (any level) on them have increased attack against Haspids.
A Haspid can kill an Archangel in one-on-one combat, alongside the Ancient Behemoth and the Titan (Titan wins by defending 4 times and then attacking). They are also the only unit besides the Titan which can reliably kill an Ancient Behemoth in one-on-one combat.
creatures.hota.cove.seadog.description:
{Seadog}

Pirates - one of the main dangers trapping seafarers. They can be found in virtually every corner of the world, though, more often, they rob the coast and sea trade routes. Skilled pirates who deserved respect among Regnan captains called Corsairs. Their skill in fencing allows them to make lightning attacks on enemies who are not able to fight back. Sea Dogs are legendary Corsairs who robbed dozens of ships. Rumored that they keep their prey on the lost islands, which many in the Endless Ocean. Sea Dogs armed with perfect pistols that created by the best alchemists of Regna. Perhaps that is why these fighters shots so deadly.

{gold|Special Ability : Ranged attack. No melee penalty. No enemy retaliation. Accurate shot.}
The Sea Dog's {Accurate Shot} is triggered after a shot: each creature in an attacking stack has a X% chance of killing a creature in the attacked squad, but the total number of killed creatures cannot be more than (number of creatures in an attacking squad) * X/100 (rounded up). X = 3 multiplier for shooting without penalty and X = 2 if shooting with penalty. Ability doesn't work if shooting at creatures behind walls.
Like with Mighty Gorgons, care should be taken to maximize Accurate Shot caps when splitting stacks of Sea Dogs. The cap is the real limiting factor: 33 Sea Dogs will never kill more than one creature with their ability, while 34 of them can kill two when shooting without penalty, 27% of the time. Likewise, 67 Sea Dogs is the minimum amount for a triple kill, but the chance of it already starts at 33%. Accurate Shots can be used as a ranged and {red|improved} version of Death Stare with ability to {gold|snipe} undead and non-living creatures down at the cost of lower efficiency per growth ratio.Ranged attack is a special ability of creatures, which allows them to attack without engaging into hand-to-hand combat. When attacking in melee, most ranged creatures suffer melee penalty, which halves their damage unless they have no melee penalty ability. Ranged penalty halves the ranged damage farther away than 10 hexes.

Sea Dogs are without question the best tier 3 creature in the game. They have great stats and a ranged version of the Mighty Gorgon's death stare ability. This is balanced by the high cost of the Gunpowder Warehouse, which prevents them from being acquired too early in the game. Pirates and Corsairs should generally be upgraded to Sea Dogs before engaging enemy players.
Sea Dogs are in fact very expensive (Unit price is 375g), combined with their regular T3 weekly growth rate, total cost rivals tier 6 creatures. It's not wise to use them in early games, as they are not cost effective.

faction.hota.bulwark.bulwark.description:
{Bulwark}

The Bulwark's inhabitants represent the peoples living on the frozen over island of Vori: Snow Elves, Jotunns, Yeti, and Kobolds. They are joined by their staunch allies, Argali and Mammoths. Their courage and unusual abilities, which they owe to the mysterious forces lurking in the eternal snows, are the stuff of legends and songs.
faction.hota.bulwark.bulwark.name: Bulwark
faction.hota.cove.cove.name: Cove
faction.hota.factory.factory.name: Factory
hero.hota.bulwark.01dhuin.biography: On the field where elves from all over Vori converge at springtime to compete in military prowess, a memorial stone with the name Dhuin Ironhand has been standing for years: no one has yet been able to hurl a dart any farther. Dhuin is as straight and firm as his famed spear, and many fathers show him the highest degree of reverence, entrusting their eldest sons to him for training.
hero.hota.bulwark.01dhuin.name: Dhuin
hero.hota.bulwark.01dhuin.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of any Snow Elves or Steel Elves by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.bulwark.01dhuin.specialty.name: Snow Elves
hero.hota.bulwark.02oidana.biography: In every tribe of Vori, someone traces their lineage back to Oidana, and she is known as the Mother of the Chieftains — only she herself has long grown weary of the ceaseless bickering among her unruly descendants. Having lived in the world for far too long to harbor preferences, she has equal affection for everyone with ancient Vori blood in their veins.
hero.hota.bulwark.02oidana.name: Oidana
hero.hota.bulwark.02oidana.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Diplomacy skill percentage when surrendering.
hero.hota.bulwark.03neia.biography: Missing the target with your only shot often means starving to death. A native of the harshest part of Vori, the Volee glacier, Neia knows it all too well; this fate has befallen many hunters of her tribe. She is one of the only Vori elves alive who prefer a bow to a powerful javelin, but Neia's aim is so perfect that even a lightweight arrow spells certain end.
hero.hota.bulwark.03neia.name: Neia
hero.hota.bulwark.03neia.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
hero.hota.bulwark.03neia.specialty.name: Archery
hero.hota.bulwark.04eikthurn.biography: The Jotunns are serious about celestial omens. Those born in the days when the Great Aries dominates the starry expanse know that their fates are forever intertwined with mountain rams, willful and awesomely brave. Ever since he learned to walk, Eikthurn has been fearlessly scaling mountain peaks in the company of his tough-horned friends, adamant in that they are the only ones incapable of betrayal.
hero.hota.bulwark.04eikthurn.name: Eikthurn
hero.hota.bulwark.04eikthurn.specialty.d: Increases the Speed of any Mountain Rams or Argali by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.bulwark.05creyle.biography: Creyle's father, the konung, refused to let her succeed him. Knowing better than to try and reason with the old grouch, she decided to find others who would accept her leadership. Creyle then went and challenged the alpha of Vori's largest mammoth herd: she wrestled him down bare-handed, snapped off his tusk and made it into a war horn. She blasts it as she leads what is now her own herd into battle.
hero.hota.bulwark.05creyle.name: Creyle
hero.hota.bulwark.05creyle.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of any Mammoths or War Mammoths by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.bulwark.06spadum.biography: Spadum is not the strongest warrior or the most skilled hunter among the Yeti; still, his kin hold him in the highest regard. The answer as to why is simple: he is fluent in the languages of all races in Vori. This often helps him settle disputes over valuable land in favor of his people without the parties resorting to needless violence.
hero.hota.bulwark.06spadum.name: Spadum
hero.hota.bulwark.06spadum.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of any Yeti or Yeti Runemasters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.bulwark.07kynr.biography: Many believe that Kynr is not a name, but rather a rank or title, because Kynr has always been among kobolds. Whenever disaster strikes the mines, and tunnels collapse, it is Kynr who leads the rescue parties. At his call, every kobold immediately suspends their dealings and obeys without question, knowing full well that lives are at stake.
hero.hota.bulwark.07kynr.name: Kynr
hero.hota.bulwark.07kynr.specialty.descr: Increases the Speed of any Kobolds or Kobold Foremen by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
hero.hota.bulwark.07kynr.specialty.name: Kobolds
hero.hota.bulwark.08ergon.biography: Ergon spent his long life in constant movement. He served in Lord Slayer's guard in Enroth, guarded elven caravans in Jadame, and sold his sword in Antagarich, only to realize in his later years that he yearned for the place whereto time itself seemed to come to rest. That said, his skill in arranging swift marches is still there, whenever need arises.
hero.hota.bulwark.08ergon.name: Ergon
hero.hota.bulwark.08ergon.specialty.desc: Receives a 5% reduction to the cost of moving on rough terrain.
hero.hota.bulwark.08ergon.specialty.name: Pathfinding
hero.hota.bulwark.09kriv.biography: When the shamans surmised that the gods would never grant their tribe another spring without a great sacrifice, the lot fell on Kriv. Chained to a runestone, he waited for death; indeed, she appeared to him as a white owl, yet only took his eyes, repaying him with the gift of seeing through time. Kriv returned to accurately predict the warm season's arrival, establishing himself as a peerless shaman.
hero.hota.bulwark.09kriv.name: Kriv
hero.hota.bulwark.09kriv.specialty.descr: Increases the Speed of any Shamans or Great Shamans by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.bulwark.09kriv.specialty.name: Shamans
hero.hota.bulwark.10glacius.biography: The expanses of Vori, covered with years of snow, only seem lifeless; those who know what to look for will find out that the disembodied inhabitants of these lands make fine interlocutors, or maybe even sources of power. Glacius has a reputation for being the Bane of Spirits: their empty shells crumble into bursts of magical light, as he greedily devours their energy and unleashes it upon his enemies.
hero.hota.bulwark.10glacius.name: Glacius
hero.hota.bulwark.10glacius.specialty.de: Casts Frost Ring with Damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.bulwark.11sial.biography: Sial can always be traced on the battlefield by shards of ice statues that once were her enemies. Legend says another doing of hers is the infamous Crystal Lake, which stays frozen even through the brief summers. Once, its waters swallowed an entire tribe whose chieftain had angered her; they remain eternally still since.
hero.hota.bulwark.11sial.name: Sial
hero.hota.bulwark.11sial.specialty.descr: Casts Ice Bolt with Damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.bulwark.11sial.specialty.name: Ice Bolt
hero.hota.bulwark.12dalton.biography: Plain weapons can barely scratch a Jotunn, but believing these hulks neglect protection exposes a fool. Dalton is the most adept armorer capable of forging equipment of such immense size. Lean as Vori's ores are, Dalton has penetrated the secrets of magic to ensure his creations can withstand anything, an ice demon's fury included.
hero.hota.bulwark.12dalton.name: Dalton
hero.hota.bulwark.12dalton.specialty.des: Casts Shield with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.bulwark.13biarma.biography: Everyone in Vori knows: when all remedies fail, the last and only resort for the ailing is to seek out old Biarma. Those who dare to face her no longer care for Biarma's motives as to who will be granted a new lease on life, and who will instead donate their skull to the eerie adornment of her remote abode's palisade.
hero.hota.bulwark.13biarma.name: Biarma
hero.hota.bulwark.13biarma.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.hota.bulwark.14akka.biography: The yeti's knack for survival in the frost is often attributed to their thick hides and dense fur. However, their resilience stems from an innate magical power that radiates warmth throughout their bodies. Only a select few can consciously harness it, and Akka is among the most adept. Her expertise stems from her deep understanding of the warlike furor her clansmen tend to give in to.
hero.hota.bulwark.14akka.name: Akka
hero.hota.bulwark.14akka.specialty.descr: Casts Bloodlust with effect increased by 3 for level 1–2 creatures, by 2 for level 3–4 creatures, and by 1 for level 5–6 creatures.
hero.hota.bulwark.14akka.specialty.name: Bloodlust
hero.hota.bulwark.15vehr.biography: Vehr earned her moniker, Goldtooth, long before replacing her worn-out fangs with ones of pure metal. To this day, her teeth remain the primary tool of her trade, as she possesses the remarkable talent to discern a rock's composition simply by biting into it. Being so blessed, she does not waste time on trifles; her expertise lies in finding rich gold veins.
hero.hota.bulwark.15vehr.name: Vehr
hero.hota.bulwark.15vehr.specialty.descr: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.hota.bulwark.15vehr.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.hota.bulwark.16allora.biography: This mysterious woman once fled to Vori from the mainland, allegedly facing execution for interfering with the succession in some barony. Allora herself denies this, but her excellent magic skills can affect the bodies and minds of other sentient beings alike. This might be the only reason she was accepted at Vori and hasn't been exiled yet.
hero.hota.bulwark.16allora.name: Allora
hero.hota.bulwark.16allora.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.hota.bulwark.17haugir.biography: Haugir's mother sailed the seas, one day returning from a voyage to distant lands with a child in her womb. Her son's greatest gripe was his eyes lacking a true frost giant's icy tinge, so he vowed to acquire the largest, purest crystals and carve himself a new pair out of them. Thus far, Haugir has found one that fits the purpose, but he still seeks its perfect match.
hero.hota.bulwark.17haugir.name: Haugir
hero.hota.bulwark.17haugir.specialty.des: In the presence of Navigation skill hero receives a bonus of 5% extra movement points at sea per level.
hero.hota.cove.01corkes.biography: Not many wish to get into Corkes' enemy list.  This quick-tempered pirate is one of the most experienced and cruel sea dogs. Many merchants know that it is better to submit the goods willingly than to start a suicidal battle with him.  He is easily distinguishable by the eye patch that he never takes off.
hero.hota.cove.01corkes.name: Corkes
hero.hota.cove.01corkes.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
hero.hota.cove.01corkes.specialty.name: Offense
hero.hota.cove.02jeremy.biography: Brother of legendary Bidley. Not as harsh and lucky, Jeremy loves fun, brewages and beautiful women. He has a thing for weapons, and collects all the newest inventions. A shot thunder is more pleasing for him than any music. Crewmen say that he is able to kill a gull a hundred feet away from a cannon.
hero.hota.cove.02jeremy.name: Jeremy
hero.hota.cove.02jeremy.specialty.descri: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Cannon by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.02jeremy.specialty.name: Cannon
hero.hota.cove.03illor.biography: Illor fled AvLee after his kin could no more bear his stuck-up demeanor. Sky high self-esteem led him to obsession with aerial creatures. He found himself a captain of a pirate ship, but his attitude got old among the crew quickly. Marooned on an island which giant flying beasts made their nesting place, Illor ended up making sky dwellers tame after a few years.
hero.hota.cove.03illor.name: Illor
hero.hota.cove.03illor.specialty.descrip: Increases the Speed of any Stormbirds or Ayssids by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.03illor.specialty.name: Stormbirds
hero.hota.cove.04elmore.biography: Since young age Elmore has dreamt about becoming a great sailor. Spending years far from the shore, he has put a lot of effort to make his dream come true. Many pirate captains are famous for their skill of navigation, but Elmore is capable of true magic even onboard the poorest junk.
hero.hota.cove.04elmore.name: Elmore
hero.hota.cove.04elmore.specialty.descri: In the presence of Navigation skill hero receives a bonus of 5% extra movement points at sea per level.
hero.hota.cove.04elmore.specialty.name: Navigation
hero.hota.cove.05derek.biography: Derek was one of the slaves on the galleys. He started the riot once with other captives, and after killing the owners, captured the ship. Since then, Derek and his crew joined the Regna pirates. He is different from other captains in his will to work with other crewmen. He also never inflicts physical punishment.
hero.hota.cove.05derek.name: Derek
hero.hota.cove.05derek.specialty.descrip: Increases the Speed of any Crew Mates or Seamen by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.05derek.specialty.name: Crew Mates
hero.hota.cove.06leena.biography: Leena was a daughter of a noble from one of the maritime cities of Erathia. Having a wild spirit since childhood, she escaped on a stolen family caravel when her father attempted to marry her off. Surprisingly, she was able to find common language with the pirates of Regna. She is probably valued for her spirit and numerous connections on the land that she uses to operate her smuggling.
hero.hota.cove.06leena.name: Leena
hero.hota.cove.06leena.specialty.descrip: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.hota.cove.06leena.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.hota.cove.07anabel.biography: To anger the daughter of Earless Nylse means to sign a death pact. Every pirate understands that there is no woman more deadly and insidious than Anabel. Her father was one of the cruelest corsairs, and his daughter follows his steps. Her grace and skill encourages men to fight at their limits.
hero.hota.cove.07anabel.name: Anabel
hero.hota.cove.07anabel.specialty.descri: Increases the Speed of any Pirates, Corsairs or Sea Dogs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.07anabel.specialty.name: Pirates
hero.hota.cove.08cassiopeia.biography: It is said that Cassiopeia was the lover of some Regnan mage, and fell victim to one of his unsuccessful experiments.  It is unknown if it is truly possible to turn an alive soul into a nymph. All that is known is that other nymphs accept Cassiopeia for more than an equal kind. They gladly follow her into the battle.
hero.hota.cove.08cassiopeia.name: Cassiopeia
hero.hota.cove.08cassiopeia.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of any Nymphs or Oceanids by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.09miriam.biography: This girl has a dark past. Once a ranger, she could see the enemies and obstacles to the farthest distance away. After a disagreement with the "colleagues" she joined the pirates. She got a "Sharp-eye" nickname amongst the bandits.
hero.hota.cove.09miriam.name: Miriam
hero.hota.cove.09miriam.specialty.descri: Increases Scouting radius by 1 for every 6 levels.
hero.hota.cove.09miriam.specialty.name: Scouting
hero.hota.cove.10bidley.biography: Bidley is one of the most successful pirates operating near Erathia shores. He is ready to accept any challenge and is able to emerge unscathed from any situation. It seems like he has a rival in every world's corner, but he is always able to escape the trouble. Apart from being an excellent warrior, having artisan skills in both pistol and sabre wielding, he also trains his crew personally.
hero.hota.cove.10bidley.name: Bidley
hero.hota.cove.10bidley.specialty.descri: Can upgrade Pirates or Corsairs to Sea Dogs.
hero.hota.cove.10bidley.specialty.name: Sea Dogs
hero.hota.cove.11tark.biography: He is a king of a half-legendary sea kin that was counted extinct. Tark realized that in order for his people to return he has to get help from powerful allies. Pirates became his new brothers in arms. As all nix, he is a powerful warrior, able to fight on land and sea. Other nix praise him and hold as a great example.
hero.hota.cove.11tark.name: Tark
hero.hota.cove.11tark.specialty.descript: Increases the Speed of any Nix or Nix Warriors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.11tark.specialty.name: Nix
hero.hota.cove.12casmetra.biography: The leader of the mysterious priestesses' cult that worships the sea has stepped out from the shadows not so long ago. Nobody knows whom this woman was and where did she came from.  However, everyone who met Casmetra mentions her beauty and her power in magic. Many believed that she joined the pirates in pursuit of her own goals. However, with years to pass the priestesses and the corsairs became closest allies.
hero.hota.cove.12casmetra.name: Casmetra
hero.hota.cove.12casmetra.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of any Sea Witches or Sorceresses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.cove.12casmetra.specialty.name: Sea Witches
hero.hota.cove.13eovacius.biography: Eovacius never learnt magic. All his magical talent was inborn. He was raised in a maritime city where he used his talent to steal on the markets. He became a prosperous and influential man until he got too many annoying and powerful rivals in the government. After that the natural born mage left his homeland and chose the life of a pirate.
hero.hota.cove.13eovacius.name: Eovacius
hero.hota.cove.13eovacius.specialty.desc: Each battle the first cast of Clone spell summons 2 clones of the target unit.
hero.hota.cove.13eovacius.specialty.name: Clone
hero.hota.cove.14spint.biography: Spint once was a very talented apprentice mage learning at the academy in Bracada. He was caught by the Krewlod barbarians and sold as a slave on galley. The galley captain noticed his magical power and offered him a boatswain position. Now Spint is a captain himself. He sinks the ships near the shores of Krewlod and enjoys his new life.
hero.hota.cove.14spint.name: Spint
hero.hota.cove.14spint.specialty.descrip: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.hota.cove.14spint.specialty.name: Sorcery
hero.hota.cove.15andal.biography: While being an experienced pirate, Andal did not always consider himself as a mage or a rogue. He was an ordinary merchant until bankrupting and getting too many debts one day. He started searching for a way to get fast and easy money. After leaving his home, he shortly returned as a known smuggler. He usually trades gems and mountain crystals. It is a mystery where he gets them from, however.
hero.hota.cove.15andal.name: Andal
hero.hota.cove.15andal.specialty.descrip: Increases kingdom's crystal production by 1 per day.
hero.hota.cove.15andal.specialty.name: +1 Crystal
hero.hota.cove.16manfred.biography: Even the most vicious pirate hunters stay away from this outlander. Nobody knows where Manfred came, but it is known that he can wage fire on galleons with a single hand swing. Pirates dislike Manfred for his horrible accent and his not any less horrible character; however they respect him as a mercenary battle mage.
hero.hota.cove.16manfred.name: Manfred
hero.hota.cove.16manfred.specialty.descr: Casts Fireball with Damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.cove.16manfred.specialty.name: Fireball
hero.hota.cove.17zilare.biography: Zilare was a library keeper in Erathia, having dedicated his life to browsing through old archives. However, he couldn't always keep things together in his head. Fired over supposed stealing a rare book, he became a cook on a pirate ship. Later life led Zilare to developing arcane powers. He learned to control the memory of allies and enemies alike.
hero.hota.cove.17zilare.name: Zilare
hero.hota.cove.17zilare.specialty.name: Forgetfulness
hero.hota.cove.18astra.biography: There is little known about Astra's past, and she does not hurry to tell much. The only detail known is that she visited almost every corner of the world in order to master the Water Magic. She fulfilled her wish of mastering this school after joining the Sea Priestesses.
hero.hota.cove.18astra.name: Astra
hero.hota.cove.18astra.specialty.descrip: Casts Cure with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.cove.18astra.specialty.name: Cure
hero.hota.cove.19dargem.biography: Dargem's past is quite legendary. They say that he alone captured a fort; the defenders' arrows simply could not reach him. Little is known of the time Dargem spent in the dungeons of Nighon as an apprentice warlock, but it's obvious that underworld magic is his ace. Barraging his ship with cannonballs and arrows is a notorious waste of time.
hero.hota.cove.19dargem.name: Dargem
hero.hota.cove.19dargem.specialty.descri: Casts Air Shield with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.cove.19dargem.specialty.name: Air Shield
hero.hota.cove.balfour.biography: Black Balfour is a powerful pirate leader who loves to collect treasures from all over the world, but in fact he has no interest in appreciating treasures. To be honest, he is an uncouth and all-around nasty character.
hero.hota.cove.balfour.name: Balfour
hero.hota.cove.balfour.specialty.name: Forgetfulness
hero.hota.factory.01henrietta.biography: Even a humble halfling from the Eeofol backwoods is capable of a feat when an unprecedented calamity knocks at the door. The new world, devoid of thatched roofs, carrot beds, or the incessant grumbling of geezers, has changed Henrietta, and she is now ready to change it herself. Kreegan fire reduced her homeland to ashes and scorched her heart, but she used it to forge herself a steel will.
hero.hota.factory.01henrietta.name: Henrietta
Increases the Speed of any Halflings or Halfling Grenadiers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.02sam.biography: Since ancient times, earth oil had wreaked havoc on the farmers of Jadame, erupting in fountains and laying waste to their crops and pastures. Sam, the daughter and apprentice of a skilled blacksmith, was the first to tame this black beast by forcing it into a pipe and making it heat her forge. Her inventions made earth oil into Burton's blood, food, and arms.
hero.hota.factory.02sam.name: Sam
hero.hota.factory.02sam.specialty.descri: Increases the Speed of any Mechanics or Engineers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.02sam.specialty.name: Mechanics
hero.hota.factory.03tancred.biography: Back in his alchemist days, Tancred discovered an ancient recipe for a concoction that exploded without the use of magic. To his great dismay, the crucial component - saltpeter - was nearly entirely absent from Antagarich. Only in Jadame did Tancred discover vast caves full of this rare element and perfect the design of the arquebus that hurls tiny bullets with awesome power.
hero.hota.factory.03tancred.name: Tancred
hero.hota.factory.03tancred.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of any Gunslingers or Bounty Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.04melchior.biography: Melchior can see everything that is going on in the deepest recesses of someone else's mind. This secret talent provides a crucial advantage when assessing the foe's strength and intentions and convincing him to agree to terms. Any prince who enlists Melchior's services can be certain of never having to plead for a disgraceful peace.
hero.hota.factory.04melchior.name: Melchior
hero.hota.factory.04melchior.specialty.d: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Diplomacy skill percentage when surrendering.
hero.hota.factory.05floribert.biography: Floribert is regarded as one of Enroth's finest field surgeons, having introduced numerous new tools that speed up manipulations and therefore alleviate the suffering of the wounded. Floribert gets a steady supply of practicing material from his girlfriend Victoria's experiments.
hero.hota.factory.05floribert.name: Floribert
Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.hota.factory.06wynona.biography: Dark elves are renowned as travelers and explorers. Since she was a girl, Wynona loved exploring the wilderness outside Alvar and the Murmurwoods, tracking animals and taking notes of their habits. She eventually became the foremost expert on Jadamean fauna, having learned a great deal from her flying, crawling, and hopping friends.
hero.hota.factory.06wynona.name: Wynona
hero.hota.factory.06wynona.specialty.des: Increases Scouting radius by 1 for every 6 levels.
hero.hota.factory.07dury.biography: Dury spent the longest time in search for a magician who would not just promise to, but actually eliminate the repercussions of wounds she had sustained in dozens of clashes. One excellent blacksmith was able to forge a siertal plate to replace the part of her skull caved in by a wyvern's tail, and the mercenary now values fine armor far more than any magical malarkey.
hero.hota.factory.07dury.name: Dury
hero.hota.factory.07dury.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
hero.hota.factory.07dury.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.hota.factory.08morton.biography: Morton, a veteran of Goblin-Ogre Wars and one of the few who survived the assault on Gowdar Deep, vowed vengeance on the "dirtskins" for the massacre that wiped his home off the face of Jadame. He gauges the quality of his ballistae by the number of ogres they can pierce with a single shot.
hero.hota.factory.08morton.name: Morton
hero.hota.factory.08morton.specialty.des: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.09tavin.biography: Tavin might be the only halfling to have ever joined the army of Erathia. His kinsmen disapprove of his lifestyle as these creatures abhor adventure. However, they do respect Tavin, even if they are wary around him and tend to avoid his company. When Kreegans invaded Eeofol, Tavin quickly became a leader of local resistance; to this day he stands ready to defend his homeland.
hero.hota.factory.09tavin.name: Tavin
hero.hota.factory.09tavin.specialty.desc: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
hero.hota.factory.09tavin.specialty.name: Offense
hero.hota.factory.10murdoch.biography: Murdoch is one to call a professional soldier of fortune. He likes few things more than money and fame. Those urges are what led Murdoch to gather a company of fellow daredevils and head out to seek adventures in Jadamean wilderness. Who knows where fate will take him next.
hero.hota.factory.10murdoch.name: Murdoch
hero.hota.factory.10murdoch.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
hero.hota.factory.11celestine.biography: The AvLeean druid, who had lost his grove, traversed the world, imparting knowledge on anyone who sought it. He left the secrets of natural magic and his daughter Mirlanda in Tatalia, while in Eeofol, Celestine was born, inheriting another facet of his talent. Her father taught her how to tame the most violent beasts, offering them friendship, rather than the Tatalian beastmasters' trademark ruthless treatment.
hero.hota.factory.11celestine.name: Celestine
Increases the Speed of any Armadillos or Bellwether Armadillos by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.12todd.biography: Few Bracada scientists have actually seen, let alone handled, a hammer or a furnace. Todd, however, had to learn how to use them, unable to convey his esoteric ideas to blacksmiths and coppersmiths. There was also a scarcity of instruments and materials vital to his research in Bracada; Todd journeyed halfway around the world in search of them before finding what he sought in Burton.
hero.hota.factory.12todd.name: Todd
hero.hota.factory.12todd.specialty.descr: Increases the Speed of any Automatons or Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.12todd.specialty.name: Automatons
hero.hota.factory.13agar.biography: Many thought the warlock Agar a madman, and then a dead man. While the latter has been proven incorrect, there is still no unanimity in Enroth's scientific community on the former. Indeed, Agar's creations are undeniably viable and functional - but could a scientist in his right mind think of instilling such nasty inclinations and proclivities in a living being?
hero.hota.factory.13agar.name: Agar
hero.hota.factory.13agar.specialty.descr: Increases the Speed of any Sandworms or Olgoi-Khorkhoi by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.13agar.specialty.name: Sandworms
hero.hota.factory.14bertram.biography: Few dwarves are capable of not just making a fortune, but also of making it work. Bertram left his father's house as soon as his beard grew two fingers long. Wandering around Antagarich, he grew fabulously rich through investing in alchemical and magical ventures. His gold paid for the embodiment of many ideas that today underpin Burton's power.
hero.hota.factory.14bertram.name: Bertram
hero.hota.factory.14bertram.specialty.de: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.hota.factory.15wrathmont.biography: Wrathmont's volatile temper got him into countless problems in his life, most notably during the carve-up of Archibald Ironfist's estate, when former colleagues banded together against the warlock, weary of his tantrums. Barely escaping them, Wrathmont fled Enroth. He spent years searching for and studying old stone tablets, learning to control his fury and stoke it in others instead.
hero.hota.factory.15wrathmont.name: Wrathmont
Casts Frenzy with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.factory.16ziph.biography: Ziph had long served as a maid to an old mage who looked down on her and her kin. The wizard had no idea that "ziph" meant "freedom" in Gremlish, much less did he suspect that she was listening in on his lectures. One day, Ziph crammed half of her master's lab into a magic bag, hid in a ship's hold, and fled Bracada for good.
hero.hota.factory.16ziph.name: Ziph
hero.hota.factory.16ziph.specialty.descr: Casts Lightning Bolt with Damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.factory.16ziph.specialty.name: Lightning Bolt
hero.hota.factory.17victoria.biography: Higher magic can even restore the dead, but can a simple infantryman who stepped on a landmine count on having someone work it on him? Victoria's fascination with such an insidious weapon did not earn her colleagues' respect, yet she committed her life to perfecting it. After meeting Floribert, the inventor found another use for her engineering knowledge, designing mechanical limbs for crippled warriors.
hero.hota.factory.17victoria.name: Victoria
hero.hota.factory.17victoria.specialty.d: Casts Land Mine with Damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the targeted creature.
hero.hota.factory.18eanswythe.biography: According to hearsay, it was Eanswythe who concocted the potion that poisoned Regna's first emperor Hareck before fleeing for Jadame. If that is indeed the case, then she must be at least six centuries old. Ordinary people don't live that long, and whoever this enigmatic crone is, everyone knows: she merely has to raise an eyebrow to make even the most formidable soldiers drop their swords and spears.
hero.hota.factory.18eanswythe.name: Eanswythe
Casts Weakness with effect increased by 3 for 1-2 level creatures, by 2 for 3-4 level creatures, and by 1 for 5-6 level creatures.
hero.hota.factory.19frederick.biography: Frederick had been living a life of an ordinary Bracadan mage and alchemist, even if a bit more inquiring than his fellows. Curiosity first brought him to experimenting with mechanisms, and eventually lured him into doing forbidden research. In the end, Frederick had to flee from Bracada, and now he searches for a better place to devote himself to what he wants.
hero.hota.factory.19frederick.name: Frederick
Increases the Speed of any Automatons or Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.elderian.biography: Elderian, living in Enroth, seeks to research forbidden magic. He has visited many scholars but cannot find what he truly seeks. It is said that he can complete his research in Burton. He wouldn't care even if it meant joining the ranks of evil.
hero.hota.factory.elderian.name: Elderian
hero.hota.factory.elderian.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of any Automatons or Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.jangaard.biography: Jangaard, inherently cruel, was once feared throughout Raven Shore's pirate crew. He now appears to have joined Kastore's guard, serving his ruthless master. On the battlefield, Jangaard always delivers a surprise attack.
hero.hota.factory.jangaard.name: Jangaard
hero.hota.factory.jangaard.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of any Gunslingers or Bounty Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.stina.biography: Stina, who has always lived in Burton, is willing to cooperate with anyone for survival. This girl is incredibly brave; it is said she dared to face over a dozen raiders alone in the desert and repel them.
hero.hota.factory.stina.name: Stina
hero.hota.factory.stina.specialty.descri: Increases the Speed of any Mechanics or Engineers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.stina.specialty.name: Mechanics
hero.hota.factory.umender.biography: The elderly Umender had spent much time studying mechanical operation; he was an expert in the field. It was precisely because of this that, after arriving in Burton by chance, he developed many strange mechanical devices for King Kastore. But he was not satisfied with his current achievements.
hero.hota.factory.umender.name: Umender
hero.hota.factory.umender.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of any Automatons or Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.factory.umender.specialty.name: Automatons
hero.hota.factory.valquest.biography: Valquest, who traverses the desert, possesses exceptional medical skills. He has joined Kastore's ranks and is teaching his skills to others. Although he appears cruel, he has a compassionate heart for small animals.
hero.hota.factory.valquest.name: Valquest
hero.hota.factory.valquest.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.hota.factory.winzells.biography: Winzells, who always considers himself a gentleman, pays particular attention to his appearance, constantly sourcing the finest fabrics to make his clothes. However, when he appears on the battlefield, he is anything but gentlemanly.
hero.hota.factory.winzells.name: Winzells
hero.hota.factory.winzells.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offense skill percentage.
hero.hota.heroes.areshrak.biography: Areshrak is a lizardman from the Couatl Islands off the coast of Jadame, who is a subordinate of Pactal. Usurped control of breeding wyverns, gorgons and other creatures after betraying the former breeder, and he handles relations with the local flight of Rust Dragons.
hero.hota.heroes.areshrak.name: Areshrak
hero.hota.heroes.areshrak.specialty.desc: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.heroes.areshrak.specialty.name: Ballista
hero.hota.heroes.athe.biography: Athe doesn't care about her own situation, nor does she care about the benefits of following the Kreegan demons. In her eyes, all creatures are equal, whether they are efreet, genie, human or demon.
hero.hota.heroes.athe.name: Athe
hero.hota.heroes.athe.specialty.descript: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.hota.heroes.athe.specialty.name: Sorcery
hero.hota.heroes.beatrice.biography: Beatrice was a talented follower of Erathian scouts - not yielding much to famous elven pathfinders. Talents of the girl had been noticed by Catherine herself and thence former scout became a general. However, her skills are still with her, she is one of the best at her cause.
hero.hota.heroes.beatrice.name: Beatrice
hero.hota.heroes.beatrice.specialty.desc: Increases Scouting radius by 1 for every 6 levels.
hero.hota.heroes.beatrice.specialty.name: Scouting
hero.hota.heroes.boyd.biography: All scary stories feature a horseman who had been hanged, stabbed or even beheaded and now rides by night, intending to exact revenge on his killers. Nonsense, a necromancer would say, a dead man risen by himself cannot have memory or will. It may well be so, but then Boyd has scores to settle not only with the traitor who slayed him, but also with the one who denied him rest in peace.
hero.hota.heroes.boyd.name: Boyd
hero.hota.heroes.boyd.specialty.descript: Increases the Speed of any Skeletons or Skeleton Warriors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
hero.hota.heroes.boyd.specialty.name: Skeletons
hero.hota.heroes.gruezak.biography: In Kilgor's army, everyone fights, from the chieftain himself to the lowliest pack-bearer, not to mention the cooks, whose managery spans not only over cauldrons, but also over huge butcher's cleavers. Should one take a close look at Gruezak, one would be surprized to find out he also possesses an array of combat skills hardly expected from a pan and ladle expert; but who on earth would want to scrutinize a run-of-the-mill cook, and an orc, to boot?
hero.hota.heroes.gruezak.name: Gruezak
hero.hota.heroes.gruezak.specialty.descr: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.heroes.gruezak.specialty.name: Ballista
hero.hota.heroes.hotaMaximus.biography: Maximus is one of Kastore's closest associates, a strong and fierce warrior. He is in charge of the necromancer country's defenses while Kastore is away.
hero.hota.heroes.hotaMaximus.name: Maximus
hero.hota.heroes.hotaMaximus.specialty.d: Increases Black Knights or Dread Knights Attack, Defense, and Damage by 10.
hero.hota.heroes.kinkeria.biography: Kinkeria was one of the most respected witches of her tribe. She was always seeking for knowledge, and it was easy for her to comprehend the essence of any phenomena. She has been given such tasks over which many wisemen remained puzzled for years. With that being said, it was no surprise when she offered her service to the king of Tatalia.
hero.hota.heroes.kinkeria.name: Kinkeria
hero.hota.heroes.kinkeria.specialty.name: Learning
hero.hota.heroes.kydoimos.biography: Kydoimos's name was the personification of the din of battle, confusion, uproar and hubbub in mythology. He is a powerful warlord in Kreegan.
hero.hota.heroes.kydoimos.name: Kydoimos
hero.hota.heroes.kydoimos.specialty.desc: Increases all Dragons’ Attack and Defense by 5.
hero.hota.heroes.kydoimos.specialty.name: Dragons
hero.hota.heroes.miseria.biography: Miseria is a young demon in Kreegan, wild and irresponsible. She rarely thinks about the consequences of her actions. Or does she not care? She acts on her feelings, and that's all she cares about.
hero.hota.heroes.miseria.name: Miseria
hero.hota.heroes.miseria.specialty.descr: Casts Resurrection with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.hota.heroes.miseria.specialty.name: Resurrection
hero.hota.heroes.pactal.biography: Pactal is the leader of the Nightcrawlers. He is cunning and cruel, and possesses the artifact 'Hollow Eye'. Because he cruelly devours the young of the Lizardmen, he is nicknamed 'Child Eater'. Under his leadership, the Nightcrawlers tribe gradually grew stronger and enslaved the people of the Bloodied Feather Clan.
hero.hota.heroes.pactal.name: Pactal
hero.hota.heroes.pactal.specialty.descri: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
hero.hota.heroes.pactal.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.hota.heroes.ranloo.biography: Following a childhood dream, Ranloo became an aide at Mestley's armory. Ancient master's gift was no lore, rather a bite to the neck and a pit in the Talon woods. Undeath wasn't fun, but Ranloo's hands got as crafty as ever. Soon he was wearing Mestley's Master Blacksmith diadem after running him through with a missile from a self-designed ballista.
hero.hota.heroes.ranloo.name: Ranloo
hero.hota.heroes.ranloo.specialty.descri: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.heroes.ranloo.specialty.name: Ballista
hero.hota.heroes.zog.biography: Zog the Cruel is the leader of the ogres in the Jadame. Possessing the 'Ironfist of the Ogre', he is so powerful that he allows ogres and orcs to wreak havoc on this wasteland, thus establishing his own tribe.
hero.hota.heroes.zog.name: Zog
hero.hota.heroes.zog.specialty.descripti: Increases the Speed of any Ogres or Ogre Magi by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.hota.heroes.zog.specialty.name: Ogres
hero.hota.interference.giselle.biography: A fair took place once in the village where Giselle lived. An old druid from a nearby grove agreed to show the villagers a few simple magic tricks. Nothing he tried seemed to work out, but the old man was able to accurately pinpoint the grinning girl in the front row as the cause of his woes.
hero.hota.interference.giselle.name: Giselle
hero.hota.interference.giselle.specialty: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Interference skill percentage.

heroClass.hota.bulwark.elder.name: Elder
